name: Valdehorna (Spain)
description: Divided by a stepped yellow band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, blue at the upper hoist and red at the lower fly, charged with a crowned shield of the bars of Aragon between crossed tools.
history: Municipal flag of Valdehorna; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: stepped band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
crowned shield of the bars of Aragon between crossed tools at the upper hoist
